summary: Applied Optoelectronics filed an 8-K reporting that on September 4, 2026 it entered a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Blue Ridge Commerce Center West LLC to buy a Houston industrial property at 16851 Blue Ridge Commerce Dr., Building 3, exercising a one-time purchase option under a February 10, 2026 lease. The property spans roughly 8.858 acres with a 153,928-square-foot building; the $26,783,472 price was paid in cash at closing via special warranty deed. This is a routine commercial real estate purchase, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle applies.
